Keisha (Support): Heads-up: KitePilot seeing 403 on SSO provisioning, activation blocked. Renewal in ~10 days, customer upset. Escalating to CS for priority handoff.
Lina (Customer Success): Acknowledged. Can you drop the error snippet and primary contact?
Keisha (Support): Log: 2024-05-22T09:41:12Z authproxy ERROR tenant=kitepilot code=403 detail="idp_token_invalid" user_email=j.doe@kitepilot.ai. Primary: Jordan Cole (ops). They said 'need this live by next week'.
Ops Bot: Alert INC-4821 created: authproxy-sso returned 5x 403 in 7m for tenant=kitepilot.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Short-term workaround: issue 24h onboarding service key to finish provisioning while IdP cert is rotated. Cmd: redwoodctl keys create --tenant=kitepilot --scope=onboard --ttl=24h. Requires Ops approval.
Ethan (Account Exec): KitePilot is strategic mid-market. Please cc me on comms; I'll prep renewal talking points.
Lina (Customer Success): Proposed comms: 1) Immediate ack + workaround offer (<2h). 2) Rotate IdP cert + verify (target 24h). 3) Pre-renewal check and usage readout (within 7d). I'll own outreach.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Temp key prep ~5min. Cert rotation on our side ~30-60min; customer must provide IdP admin access or one-time link.
Keisha (Support): Customer sentiment: 'we're on the clock' and may evaluate alternatives. Marking renewal risk elevated.
Lina (Customer Success): Action items: Keisha send incident link/logs; Ben standby for temp key after Ops approval; Ethan join verification call. Scheduling 15m warm handoff in 30m.
Keisha (Support): Incident link DM'd to Lina; logs uploaded to INC-4821.
Ben (Onboarding Eng): Temp key ready on standby.
Lina (Customer Success): Sending initial note to Jordan now (apology + workaround). Will update renewal risk tracker after handoff.
